status: C2.1 sync foundation local implementation; isolated metadata API; not production
transport_gate: Every /internal/c2 route is absent in production and requires C2_TEST_KEY in local or staging. This gate is independent from the Coach session required by management reads.

response.envelope: Common Cloudflare success/failure envelope with request correlation and backend identity.
response.operation_result: A mutation returns an immutable operation receipt and result. Sync metadata import does not call Google or consume outbox.

/internal/c2/import-sync-foundation.notes: Versioned shadow import for unique per-season Google Form and Spreadsheet bindings, numeric Sheet tab IDs, explicit field mappings, normalized dependency-group baselines and exact stable Form or legacy source identities. Omitted rows are not deletions. It creates no Google outbox and performs no external I/O.

/internal/c2/get-sync-overview.notes: Protected C2.1 diagnostic projection. File identifiers remain private. Counts cover the active binding, review sources, open conflicts, pending batches and pending business outbox.
